belay.1: Belay on the ledge up and right of the small tree, directly under the big roof.
belay.2: After turning the lip of the roof, climb about twelve feet more to a ledge; the belay there takes thin gear.
belay.3: The pitch ends on a large ledge with trees, reached after the dihedral; a full rope length gets you there.
belay.8: Back and left up the short chimney to a roomy ledge that is better than the one below.

belay.P1: Bolted anchor just past the blind arete, reached by stepping right after the pale slab.
belay.P2: Belay at the foot of the main slab, after following the ledge off to the right.
belay.P8: Belay at the top of the easy off-width that finishes the route.
